_: One table, two readers: Scripts/Read-OrgChart.ps1 (tkTestToolkit -OrgChart, Tests/Test-OrgChart.ps1) and the agent's reader. A case builds a scratch hub: hub.json when hubJson is given, org.json from `org` (an object), `orgText` (the raw file text) or `orgFile` (a file under this folder; no org.json when none is given), and an empty prompt file for each name in `prompts` (the table's `prompts` unless the case has its own) in the agentic folder -- agentic/, or `promptsFolder` -- plus an empty folder for each name in promptFolders. A position's prompt is looked up in three folders, in order (docs/hub/org.md, "Where a position's prompt is found"): `hubOrgPrompts` are empty files in the hub's roles folder (agentic/org/, or `promptsFolder`/org/), `prompts` the hub's agentic folder as above, and `shippedPrompts` the toolkit's own agentic/org/ -- each case reads against a scratch package holding exactly those (none when absent), with `shippedFlatPrompts` in that package's flat agentic/, which the lookup does not read. `expect.promptRefs`, by position id, is the reading-room ref the agent's route gives the prompt it chose (`yours/<name>` for the hub's copy, `<name>` for the toolkit's), and only the agent asserts it. `tree` is the one asked for besides the file's own. `expect.status` is ok, missing or invalid. For ok: `activeTree`, `seatCount` (the seats of the tree shown), `warnings` (exact sentences, in order) and `chart` -- the response, compared as JSON, key order aside (docs/hub/org.md, "The response"); `text` is the CLI's lines for it and only the CLI asserts it. Otherwise `kind` is the contract both halves agree on, and `message` is the sentence the CLI says; a reader in another half may say the same sentence or only the kind (`messageStartsWith` stands in for a message that carries the parser's own words). Ids are compared exactly, character for character.

cases.name: valid
cases.why: A tree shaped like ours: the owner as a person, two VPs, a PM, one lead position with three seats on three Spaces (one vacant), and a builder pool with seats [] and its default-model line; a second tree beside it; activeTree chooses the first.

cases.name: valid-second-tree-active
cases.why: The same document with activeTree naming the second tree: the chart is that tree.

cases.name: valid-tree-by-id
cases.why: The first document read with tree=branch: the other tree's chart, and activeTree still says which one the file uses.

cases.name: one-tree-no-active-tree
cases.why: One tree and no activeTree: that tree is the one in use.

cases.name: unknown-keys-and-notes
cases.why: A key the tool does not read is ignored with a warning at every level; an underscore key is a note and is not said. A position with no title shows its id, a tree with no name its id; a seat with active true or false is carried and never drawn.

warnings: org.json: 'colour' is not a key this tool reads -- ignored.
org.json: 'region' is not a key this tool reads in tree 't' -- ignored.
org.json: 'budget' is not a key this tool reads in position 'root' of tree 't' -- ignored.
org.json: 'badge' is not a key this tool reads in seat 'a' of position 'root' in tree 't' -- ignored.

cases.name: agentic-folder-renamed
cases.why: hub.json renames the agentic folder; a prompt is looked for there.

cases.name: same-position-id-in-two-trees
cases.why: The same position id in two different trees is allowed.

cases.name: the-shape-complete
cases.why: A tree in the whole shape (docs/hub/org.md, "The shape"): a title, a preset, a size, both descriptions and a room; positions with recommend; a seat's own roleTitle, its session, the seat that merges, a model by its id and one the model map does not know. No key is warned.

cases.name: title-over-name
cases.why: A tree with both title and name: the title is the title; name is still a key this tool reads, so nothing is warned.

cases.name: name-alone
cases.why: An older file's tree with name and no title: the name is the title.

cases.name: retired-keys-kept-not-drawn
cases.why: The retired keys -- a tree's machines, a seat's machine and active -- are read without a warning and are not in the response, and no machine is printed.

cases.name: keys-are-matched-exactly
cases.why: A new key spelled in another case is not that key: Title, Recommend, RoleTitle and Session are warned and ignored, so the tree's title is its id and the seat has no session.

warnings: org.json: 'Title' is not a key this tool reads in tree 't' -- ignored.
org.json: 'Recommend' is not a key this tool reads in position 'root' of tree 't' -- ignored.
org.json: 'RoleTitle' is not a key this tool reads in seat 'a' of position 'root' in tree 't' -- ignored.
org.json: 'Session' is not a key this tool reads in seat 'a' of position 'root' in tree 't' -- ignored.

cases.name: field-types
cases.why: Each new field read by its type: merges only as a JSON boolean (false is kept, "yes" is null), teamSize only as a whole number (the text "6" is null), recommend's text entries trimmed with the empty and the non-text left out (a number reads as its text) and a recommend that is not an array as none, a blank roleTitle as null, and a size the schema refuses carried as written -- the reader keeps what the file says, the schema says what a file may say.

cases.name: portrait-on-the-owner
cases.why: The owner's seat -- the root's, which consts.json org.portraitSeats names -- carries a portrait the tool draws (org.portraits): the response carries it on that seat, and the seat's line says it after the name. The name and the title are the seat's and the position's as ever.

cases.name: portrait-the-tool-does-not-draw
cases.why: A portrait that is not one of the ids, on the owner's seat, and a portrait on a seat org.portraitSeats does not name: each is ignored with a warning -- the seat is drawn as it would be without the key -- and the file is not refused. An empty portrait is no portrait, and is not said.

warnings: org.json: the portrait 'Robot' in seat 'owner' of position 'owner' in tree 't' is not one this tool draws -- ignored.
org.json: the portrait in seat 'pm' of position 'pm' in tree 't' is on a seat that takes none -- ignored.
